status: DRAFT_FOR_DEV_ONLY (never activates a forward window, never opens validation, locked, paper or IW1 data)
data_state_when_written: no data for these signals downloaded or computed in this session; the broad-universe archive is NOT on disk here and is downloaded only after this file is committed
requested_by: 동동, 2026-11-01 '해외 퀀트 대회에서 공개된 고수익 전략 찾아 적용해봐' -> survey reports/QUANT_COMPETITIONS_SURVEY_20261101.md -> decision card option '101 Alphas 일부 DEV 시험'
question: Do eight publicly disclosed WorldQuant formulaic alphas (Kakushadze 2016, '101 Formulaic Alphas', Wilmott 84, arXiv 1601.00991) that need only daily OHLCV and VWAP earn a positive, beta-adjusted return after the measured alt cost on a point-in-time top-50 Binance USDT-M universe, rebalanced weekly, on DEV data only?
what_the_author_had_already_seen: ADR 0035/0040/0041/0047/0051 cross-sectional results on the same universe and segments (all NOT_PROMISING), including 7-day reversal (REV7) and taker flow. Several 101 alphas are short-horizon reversal / volume-price correlation signals and are expected to correlate with REV7; this is disclosed. No result of any 101 alpha on crypto data has been computed by this project. Public blog posts claim 101 alphas work on crypto, mostly without costs; not used to choose the eight.
selection_of_the_eight: fixed before data: alphas whose formula uses only open/high/low/close/volume/vwap of the name itself (no industry neutralisation, no market cap, no adv beyond volume), with lookbacks <= 10 days, chosen to cover the paper's main shapes (intraday bar shape, volume-price correlation, short reversal). Chosen: #2, #6, #12, #33, #41, #53, #54, #101. No other alpha will be run under this prereg.
scope: DEV only. No validation, locked, paper or IW1 window. No criteria change, no prereg v2/v3 change. A DEV_PROMISING flag can only lead to a proposal of a NEW preregistered forward window, which needs the user's explicit go.

universe.source: every USDT-quoted symbol under data/futures/um/monthly/klines/ of the public Binance archive, including symbols delisted later; same listing rule and exclusions as prereg_broad_universe_v1.json
universe.point_in_time_rule: at each rebalance: symbols with at least 60 complete daily bars before the signal cut-off and a bar at the rebalance open, ranked by mean daily quote volume over the 30 days to the cut-off; keep the top 50 (identical to ADR 0035/0040)
universe.segment_rule: BTCUSDT is not read in S2 (ADR 0019); every symbol obeys never_read

S1.use: the only segment that decides anything

S2.use: reported, and used only in the fixed S2 > 0.5 condition of the flag

never_read: BTC validation/locked TEST + embargo, all symbols
timing: rebalance every Monday (first Monday on/after first_rebalance_from) at the 00:00 UTC daily open; positions held 7 days. Signals use daily bars that closed by Sunday 00:00 UTC (the Sunday bar is skipped, same lag as ADR 0040). The paper's alphas are daily-rebalanced; weekly is a deliberate cost-driven deviation fixed here.
portfolio: long 10 and short 10 of the 50 by alpha value (paper convention: the alpha value is the desired position, so the HIGHEST values are long), equal target weight +-1/20 (gross 1, net 0), ties by symbol name. Weights drift between rebalances; traded amount is |target - drifted weight|. Identical engine to ADR 0040 (cross_section_v2_dev.run_segment).
missing_data: never filled; a name missing any input in the alpha's window gets no value and cannot be picked. Held names without a bar earn 0 and are counted.

definitions.vwap: daily quote volume / daily base volume (kline columns 8 and 6); if base volume is 0 the value is missing
definitions.rank(x): cross-sectional percentile rank among the 50 universe names on that day
definitions.ts operators: delta(x,d)=x_t-x_{t-d}; correlation(x,y,d)=Pearson over the last d days; computed per name on daily bars ending at the cut-off
definitions.time-series of ranks: for alphas that correlate ranks over time (#2), rank is taken cross-sectionally within the current 50 names on each of the window days

hypotheses.formula: sign(delta(volume, 1)) * (-1 * delta(close, 1)); deviation: delta(close,1) divided by close_{t-1} so the cross-section is not dominated by price level
((high * low)^0.5) - vwap; deviation: divided by vwap so the cross-section is not dominated by price level
-1 * delta((((close - low) - (high - close)) / (close - low)), 9); a day with close == low gives a missing value
(-1 * ((low - close) * (open^5))) / ((low - high) * (close^5)); a day with high == low gives a missing value
((close - open) / ((high - low) + .001)); deviation: the .001 constant is replaced by 0.001*close so it is scale-free

trials: exactly these 8, each run once. Recorded as 8 DEV evaluations in run/audit/dev_search_trials.jsonl. Any change of formula, holding period, universe, side size or direction afterwards is a NEW trial with a new prereg and ADR.

cost.decides: measured alt cost record run/audit/alt_cost_measured_20261027/estimate_v3_alts.json (PE-ed757f47..., ESTIMATED_FROM_PUBLIC_DATA): per side fee 5bp + half spread 7.27bp + 0.0015*sqrt(10,000 USDT / quote volume of the 23:45-00:00 UTC 15m bar before the Monday open), charged on every traded weight
cost.funding: actual settled funding on every held position

statistics.unit: daily portfolio return on constant capital 1, simple sum
statistics.report: same as ADR 0040 plus the S1 daily correlation of each alpha with REV7-style 7-day reversal is NOT computed (not preregistered); pairwise correlation of the eight S1 series is reported
statistics.dev_flag_not_a_verdict: DEV_PROMISING only if, under the measured cost: (a) S1 annual Sharpe above the expected maximum of 8 unskilled trials over the S1 length (Bailey et al. 2014), (b) S1 beta-adjusted mean t >= 2, (c) both S1 halves positive, (d) S2 annual Sharpe > 0.5, (e) S1 annual Sharpe under measured_x2 > 0. Anything else NOT_PROMISING. The cumulative-trial null (~2.44 gross, ADR 0048) is reported next to it. The flag never opens a window.
statistics.power_note: S1 is about 2.5 years; a true SR-1 effect will most likely be flagged NOT_PROMISING. Accepted in advance.
